title: Register and access an authorized account
description: This verifies that a new employee or recruiter can register, sign in, and reach an authorized profile view.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the registration details for a new employee account
Submit the registration form
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user reaches an authorized profile or dashboard view
Verify the authenticated user profile is displayed

title: View the current profile and credentials
description: This verifies that a signed-in employee can open their profile and see their verified personal details, experiences, skills, and certifications.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the profile view
Verify the profile details are displayed
Verify verified credentials are displayed

title: Create a verification request
description: A recruiter or reviewer can create a verification request for a candidate and see it recorded as pending.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Click the verification workflows link
Start a new verification request
Fill in the required verification details
Submit the verification request
Verify a pending verification record is visible

title: Update profile credentials and keep changes after reload

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the profile view
Update one profile credential field with a new valid value
Save the profile changes
Reload the profile view
Verify the updated credential is displayed
Verify the saved profile changes persist

Submit the form

Save the review changes

Verify feature highlights are displayed

description: This verifies that an anonymous visitor can change the theme on the public homepage and the page updates its client-side styling state.

Click a navigation path that leads to an unsupported page

title: Show validation errors for malformed profile updates
description: This verifies that an employee who submits an invalid profile payload sees validation feedback and the profile is not updated.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the profile view
Enter an invalid value into a profile field that requires validation
Save the profile changes
Verify a profile validation error is visible
Verify the invalid changes are not saved

title: Reject invalid login credentials
description: This verifies that an anonymous user entering incorrect credentials sees a login failure and remains unable to access protected account data.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with fake values
Fill in the password field with fake values
Submit the login form
Verify a login error is visible
Verify protected account data is not displayed

title: Reject unauthorized recruiter posting access

steps.description: Navigate to /

Start creating a new job posting
Verify an access denied message is visible

title: Block access to profile data without signing in
description: This verifies that an unauthenticated visitor cannot open the profile view and instead sees an access denied state.

steps.description: Navigate to /profile
Verify an access denied or sign-in required state is displayed

Apply the filter
Verify a validation error is visible
